verdict.rationale: Cua documents a one-command uninstall that removes Cua Spaces and the CLI while leaving Spaces and their data in place, which directly supports leaving with your data. It also describes itself as open source infrastructure that runs any OCI image on machines you own or your own cloud accounts, and community users note Cua-Bench can export trajectories. However, there is no documented export of all account data, such as the Cua Volume, agent memory or audit log, in open formats. missing for 10: documented full account data export, specified open export formats for Volume/agent memory/audit log, account deletion/offboarding docs, independent corroboration of a clean exit.
